cross_domain_review.basis: Side-by-side review found different fruit instances, geometry, surface markings, crops, and/or species. Low distances were driven by a single centered fruit on a light background. No pair depicted the same underlying photograph or scene.

within_fruitvision_review.visual_review_design: A deterministic 30-pair sample spanning the full candidate list, including the smallest-distance and later list regions, was reviewed side by side. Exact/pixel groups were audited separately and are fully enumerated in fruitvision_dataset_audit.json.
within_fruitvision_review.interpretation: The coarse global pHash is highly sensitive to FruitVision's standardized centered-object/white-background composition. Candidate status is not treated as proof of duplication. Published records are preserved. Some dependence from repeated physical fruit/capture sessions may remain and is a stated limitation.
